key_insight: QAOA and FALQON follow distinct entanglement and coherence trajectories as they approach Minimum Vertex Cover solutions.
engineering_relevance: Tracking these resource trajectories can inform circuit-depth and algorithm choices for near-term quantum optimization without requiring full state tomography.
method: Apply QAOA and FALQON to a Minimum Vertex Cover instance.
Optimize auxiliary quantum circuits to identify closest resource-free states using the Bures metric and Uhlmann’s theorem.
Track Bures entanglement and coherence as optimization progresses.
evidence_signal: For the studied instance, QAOA shows an early entanglement peak and residual coherence, while FALQON shows a lower, later peak and smoothly decreasing coherence alongside optimization error.
watch_item: The abstract reports one problem instance, so generalization to larger graphs and noisy hardware remains unestablished.
paper_title: Resource Analysis of Quantum Optimization Algorithms via Variational Methods
